Augment too early and you waste capital. Too late and you lose revenue.

Batteries age and markets move. Without accurate life curves and a timed plan, usable capacity slips and revenue leaks away. Strategic augmentation blends health forecasting, cost curves and evolving chemistries to add the right capacity at the right time, keeping assets above contract thresholds and getting every megawatt-hour of value from the investment.

ACCURE’s health tracking showed the cells in a 100+ MWh BESS had lost ≈ 6 % more capacity than the supplier’s warranty allowed within the first two years. The original augmentation plan (adding 1.8 MWh in year 2) would not keep the plant above its required usable-capacity threshold, risking lost revenue, grid penalties and warranty disputes.

By comparing the real-life State-of-Health curve with the contractual warranty line, we quantified the shortfall and calculated how much additional energy was needed to stay compliant until the next scheduled augmentation.

Using ACCURE’s evidence, the operator successfully claimed an extra 1.45 MWh of warranty-funded augmentation, raising the year-2 top-up from 1.8 MWh to 3.3 MWh. The additional capacity (valued at ≈ $217k) secures site performance, preserves revenue, and keeps the supplier, not the operator, responsible for the accelerated ageing.
